scope: Animated narrated story (master 16:9 + derived 9:16 Shorts). Separate from pilot-qa-criteria-v3, which stays frozen and unchanged for guided-prayer-scenic.
failure_policy: Every row blocks. A FAIL is fixed in the work, never by editing these criteria. Criteria are not edited after results to pass.

fluidity.rule: Counted from the render manifest: every output frame maps to one rendered frame hash. Repeating a frame to reach the container rate is a duplicate and counts against unique_frame_ratio. Only holds declared in scenes.json are exempt, each at most hold_seconds_max.

continuity.scene_end_state_equals_next_start_state: checked from scenes.json state fields (character position, held props, wardrobe); a mismatch is a FAIL unless the scene declares a cut with a reason

subtitles.timing_source: the voice timeline (per-sentence start/end), never estimated

scripture.quote: Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.

cta.text: Subscribe to this channel for more stories of everyday faith.
cta.position: last segment; master ends within 1.0 s after it; never mid-story

render_identity.rule: One render_id = sha256 of the canonical JSON of these fields. Any change makes a new render_id; review and approval bind to it.

perceptual_review_required_before_approv: Watched critique with timestamps (acting, expressions, camera, rhythm, voice, finish) by the designated review, plus the three-stage approval. A structure that is only a candidate is piloted, never scaled.
not_claimed: Audience response, CTR, retention or revenue
That the candidate structure is validated
